تقتبسين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَبِسِينَ (taqtabisīna) /taq.ta.bi.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# تُقْتَبَسِينَ (tuqtabasīna) /tuq.ta.ba.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
